cards.tz: 输入-处理-输出周期 (IPO cycle)
cards.en:
A computer converts data into information in three steps:
  • Input: data is input into the computer through input devices.
  • Process: the program processes the input data; data in storage may be retrieved or updated during this step.
  • Output: meaningful information is output from the computer through output devices.
This is the input-process-output cycle (IPO cycle). Note that storage connects to the process step in both directions (read and write), while the program controls how processing is done. The book's example: a list of students' weights (data, input) is processed by spreadsheet software (program) on the CPU, saved on the hard disk (storage), and output as a histogram (information). In exams, always identify which item is data, which is the program, and what the useful output is.
cards.zh:
计算机把数据 (data) 变成信息 (information) 分三步：
  • Input 输入：通过输入设备把数据送进计算机。
  • Process 处理：由程序 (program) 处理数据，期间可能从储存 (storage) 读取或更新数据 (retrieved or updated)。
  • Output 输出：把有意义的信息 (meaningful information) 通过输出设备输出。
这叫 IPO cycle。注意：storage 与 process 是双向的（读和写），program 决定怎样处理。课本例子：一批学生体重（输入的数据）用试算表软件 (program) 在 CPU 处理，存到硬盘 (storage)，最后输出成直方图 (histogram，信息)。考试时要分清哪个是数据、哪个是程序、哪个是输出的信息。

ex.q: A supermarket scans items at the checkout and prints a receipt. Identify the input, process, storage and output.
ex.a:
Input: product IDs read by the barcode scanner.
Process: the POS program looks up prices and adds the total.
Storage: product database is retrieved; stock records are updated.
Output: total shown on the display and the printed receipt.
ex.az: 输入：条码扫描器读到的产品编号；处理：POS 程序查价、计总数；储存：读取产品数据库并更新存货；输出：屏幕显示总数及打印收据。

cards.en:
Input devices are responsible for the first step of the IPO cycle: they capture data from the real world and transfer it to the computer. They can be wired or wireless.
TypeExampleConnection method
WiredWired mouse, wired keyboardUniversal Serial Bus (USB) port
WirelessWireless mouse, wireless keyboardRadio frequency (RF) technology such as 2.4 GHz connection (usually with a small USB receiver/dongle); Bluetooth; Wi-Fi
Wired devices are stable and need no batteries; wireless devices give freedom of movement and a tidy desk but need power and may suffer interference. Exam trap: a USB cable is a wired method, even when the device is described as "wireless" elsewhere.
cards.zh:
输入设备 (input device) 负责 IPO 的第一步：capture data from the real world and transfer it to the computer（从现实世界撷取数据并传送到计算机）。可以是有线 (wired) 或无线 (wireless)：
  • 有线：滑鼠、键盘多用 USB port。
  • 无线：RF 射频（如 2.4 GHz，通常配一个 USB 接收器）、Bluetooth 蓝牙、Wi-Fi。
有线稳定、不用电池；无线活动自由、桌面整齐，但要供电，可能受干扰。陷阱：USB cable 属于有线连接。

ex.q: (Textbook Example 1.1 Q1) Which is/are common connection method(s) of a wireless mouse? (1) Bluetooth (2) USB cable (3) 2.4 GHz RF
ex.a: (1) and (3) are wireless methods. (2) USB cable is a wired method. Answer: (1) and (3) only.
ex.az: 蓝牙和 2.4 GHz 是无线方式；USB 线是有线，所以选 (1)(3)。

cards.en:
A full-sized keyboard has 100 or more keys. Each key is represented by a unique code; when a key is pressed, the corresponding code is sent to the computer. Gaming keyboards add features such as lighting and extra keys.

A numeric keyboard (numpad) is also a keyboard: most keys are Arabic numerals and arithmetic operators. It is mainly used in banks or point-of-sale terminals (e.g. on an ATM) for number input, password (PIN) input or calculation.

Keyboard layout (enrichment): keys may be arranged differently or missing depending on size. A tenkeyless keyboard has no numpad. A layout is usually named after its first six letters: QWERTY is the common one; AZERTY is mainly used in France. A virtual (on-screen) keyboard is shown on a touchscreen to save physical space on portable devices.
cards.zh:
全尺寸键盘有 100 个或以上的键，每个键对应一个唯一代码 (unique code)，按下时把代码传给计算机。

数字键盘 (numpad) 主要是数字和运算符号，常见于银行、ATM、销售点终端 (POS)，用来输入数字、密码或计算。

键盘布局：tenkeyless 键盘没有 numpad；布局以首六个字母命名，QWERTY 最普遍，AZERTY 主要在法国使用。触控屏上的虚拟键盘 (virtual keyboard) 可节省便携设备的实体空间。

ex.q: Why does an ATM use a numpad instead of a full keyboard?
ex.a: An ATM only needs numbers (PIN, amount). A numpad is smaller, simpler and faster for number input, and fewer keys means less chance of wrong input and less space.
ex.az: ATM 只需输入数字（密码、金额），数字键盘细小、简单、输入快，也较少出错。

cards.en:
Historical note. Before keyboards, people used typewriters, and the letters were not arranged alphabetically. Typing too fast could make typewriters malfunction (jam); it is believed QWERTY was designed to reduce typing speed to protect expensive typewriters.

Modern keyboards are more durable, not prone to malfunction and cheaper, so there is no technical reason to keep an inefficient layout. However, most typists and computer users are accustomed to QWERTY, and it would take too much effort to learn another layout. So QWERTY is still the dominating layout. Key idea for exams: a technology may persist because of user habit / switching cost, not because it is the best design.
cards.zh:
历史：键盘出现前人们用打字机 (typewriter)，字母不是按字母序排列。打字太快会令打字机卡住，一般认为 QWERTY 是为了减慢打字速度而设计。

现代键盘耐用、不易坏、便宜，本来没理由继续用低效率布局；但大部分人已习惯 QWERTY，改用其他布局要花很多精力，所以 QWERTY 仍然主导。重点：一种技术能持续往往是因为用户习惯/转换成本，未必因为设计最好。

ex.q: A company proposes switching all office keyboards to a faster layout. Give one reason against.
ex.a: Staff are accustomed to QWERTY; retraining takes time and productivity will drop during the transition.
ex.az: 员工已习惯 QWERTY，重新学习要时间，过渡期效率会下降。

cards.tz: 定点设备：动作追踪与位置追踪
cards.en:
A pointing device lets us interact with the interface of a computer: pointing, clicking, dragging, dropping, double-clicking, right-clicking, scrolling, often moving a cursor.
TypeHow it controls the cursorExamples
Motion-trackingtracks the motion of the device (relative movement)computer mouse, trackball, joystick, racing wheel
Position-trackingtracks the position where the user points at the devicetouchpad, touchscreen, graphics tablet
Example: slide a mouse right and the cursor moves right (motion). On a touchscreen, the cursor jumps to the exact position tapped (position). Some position-tracking devices accept handwriting with a finger or stylus pen.
cards.zh:
定点设备 (pointing device) 让我们与界面互动：指向、点击、拖放、双击、右键、卷动等，通常会移动游标 (cursor)。分两类：
  • Motion-tracking 动作追踪：追踪设备本身的移动，如滑鼠、轨迹球、游戏杆、驾驶盘。
  • Position-tracking 位置追踪：追踪用户在设备上指着的位置，如触控板、触控屏、绘图板。
触控屏上游标会去到正好点击的位置。部分位置追踪设备可用手指或触控笔 (stylus) 手写输入。

ex.q: Classify: trackball, graphics tablet, joystick, touchpad.
ex.a: Motion-tracking: trackball, joystick. Position-tracking: graphics tablet, touchpad.
ex.az: 动作追踪：轨迹球、游戏杆；位置追踪：绘图板、触控板。

cards.t: Computer mouse (optical, LED vs laser, mechanical)
cards.tz: 滑鼠：光学、LED 与激光、机械
cards.en:
A mouse tracks its movement on a surface to control the cursor. It has at least two buttons (left, right) and usually a scroll wheel that also works as a third button. Extra buttons can do cursor speed control, volume control, cut/copy/paste, etc.

Most mice today are optical mice: they use a light source and a light sensor at the bottom. Two light sources:
  • LED mouse: usually does not work on reflective (mirror) or transparent (glass) surfaces, because the sensor detects movement from the change of light reflected by the surface.
  • Laser mouse: works better on such surfaces because laser lets the sensor take a clearer image.
Mechanical mice (ball at the bottom) are obsolete due to limited consistency on different surfaces, heavy weight, low durability and high production cost.
cards.zh:
滑鼠 (mouse) 追踪自己在桌面上的移动来控制游标，至少有左右两个键，通常有滚轮 (scroll wheel)，也可当第三个键。

现在多数是光学滑鼠 (optical mouse)：底部有光源和光感应器。
  • LED 滑鼠：在镜面或玻璃上通常用不到，因为它靠表面反射光的变化来侦测移动。
  • 激光 (laser) 滑鼠：影像较清晰，在反光/透明表面表现较好。
机械滑鼠（底部有球）已被淘汰：不同表面一致性差、重、耐用度低、生产成本高。

ex.q: A user's mouse cursor does not move on a glass desk. Suggest the cause and a fix.
ex.a: It is probably an LED optical mouse; glass is transparent so the reflected light barely changes. Fix: use a mouse pad or switch to a laser mouse.
ex.az: 多数是 LED 滑鼠，玻璃透明令反射光变化不明显；用滑鼠垫或改用激光滑鼠。

cards.tz: 轨迹球、游戏杆与驾驶盘
cards.en:
A trackball has a ball installed in a socket; it tracks the rolling of the ball to control the cursor. Buttons around the ball handle clicking/dragging; sometimes the ball itself is a button. Advantages over a mouse: it does not depend on the surface (flat or bumpy, smooth or rough, shiny or dull), needs less space and its position can be fixed. So it is common on information kiosks (a mouse could be stolen or need desk space).

Joysticks and racing wheels are motion-tracking devices used in gaming and driver training. They give a more realistic game experience and let people learn to drive in a safe place (e.g. arcade machines, driving simulators).
cards.zh:
轨迹球 (trackball)：球装在底座内，靠球的转动控制游标，旁边有按键，有时球本身也是按键。优点：不受表面影响、所需空间少、位置可以固定，所以常见于资讯站 (information kiosk)。

游戏杆 (joystick) 和驾驶盘 (racing wheel) 用于游戏和驾驶训练，提供更真实的体验，并让人在安全地方学车。

ex.q: Why does a public information kiosk use a trackball rather than a mouse?
ex.a: The trackball can be fixed in position (cannot be taken away), needs little space, and works regardless of surface.
ex.az: 可固定、不会被拿走；占位少；不受表面影响。

cards.en:
A touchpad (common on laptops) detects the motion and pressure of the user's fingers. Tapping = left-click; right-click and scrolling via its buttons or gestures (e.g. swiping along the edge). Many support multi-touch: detecting gestures with more than one finger at the same time (e.g. pinch to zoom).

A touchscreen is both an input and an output device: like a touchpad + monitor, but the cursor goes to the exact position tapped. Users tap icons/buttons directly; usually multi-touch.
Compared with a mouse, a touchscreen tends to:
  • be easier to operate (better hand-eye coordination);
  • require less working space;
  • be unable/more difficult to do some interactions, e.g. mouse-over;
  • be more expensive.
cards.zh:
触控板 (touchpad) 侦测手指的移动和压力；轻按 = 左键，右键和卷动用按键或手势；多数支援多点触控 (multi-touch)，即同时侦测多于一只手指的手势（如两指缩放）。

触控屏 (touchscreen) 同时是输入和输出设备，游标直接到点击位置。与滑鼠相比：较易操作（手眼协调较好）、所需空间较少、难以做 mouse-over 等动作、较贵。所以滑鼠的优点是较便宜，而不是手眼协调。

ex.q: (Textbook Checkpoint 1.1 Q1) Advantage(s) of a mouse over a touchscreen: (1) lower purchase cost (2) better hand-eye coordination (3) faster text input
ex.a: (1) correct: touchscreens are more expensive. (2) wrong: that is the touchscreen's advantage. (3) neither device is for text input. Answer: (1) only.
ex.az: (1) 对；(2) 是触控屏的优点；(3) 两者都不是文字输入设备。答案 (1) only。

cards.en:
A graphics tablet (also called drawing pad / digital art board) is widely used by computer graphics designers. It is similar to a touchscreen, except that:
  • it is controlled by a pen (stylus); and
  • it has up to 8000 pressure sensitivity levels, so line thickness/darkness follows how hard the user presses, allowing all sorts of artworks.
It is a position-tracking pointing device. It is the best choice for drawing illustrations/comics and can also help people who cannot type Chinese input characters by handwriting.
cards.zh:
绘图板 (graphics tablet / drawing pad) 是电脑美术设计师常用的工具，和触控屏相似，分别是：
  • 用笔 (pen) 操控；
  • 有高达 8000 级压力感应 (pressure sensitivity levels)，下笔轻重会改变线条粗幼/深浅。
属于位置追踪定点设备。画漫画、插画最适合用它；也可用来手写输入中文。

ex.q: Which device is most suitable for creating comic illustrations: mouse, touchscreen, drawing tablet, trackball?
ex.a: Drawing (graphics) tablet: pen control and many pressure levels give natural strokes.
ex.az: 绘图板：用笔，并有大量压力感应级别。

cards.t: Audio input: microphone, speech recognition, MIDI keyboard
cards.tz: 音频输入：咪高峰、语音识别、MIDI 键盘
cards.en:
Audio input devices create digital audio files.
  • Microphone: records analog sound waves and converts them into electrical signals; the computer's sound card usually converts these into digital audio files.
  • Speech recognition: microphones can also input text or instructions by voice, e.g. virtual assistants Siri and Google Assistant.
  • MIDI keyboard: Musical Instrument Digital Interface (MIDI) is a file format storing musical notes or digitally sampled sounds, not a recorded sound. A MIDI keyboard inputs these notes; unlike a microphone it is not affected by ambient noise.
cards.zh:
音频输入设备用来制作数码音频档。
  • 咪高峰 (microphone)：把类比声波转成电子讯号，再由声效卡 (sound card) 转为数码音频档。
  • 语音识别 (speech recognition)：用声音输入文字或指令，如 Siri、Google Assistant。
  • MIDI 键盘：MIDI 档储存的是音符或数码取样声音，不是录音。MIDI 键盘输入音符，不受环境噪音影响。

ex.q: A composer records a melody in a noisy room. Microphone or MIDI keyboard? Why?
ex.a: MIDI keyboard: it records note data directly, so ambient noise does not affect it; notes can also be edited later.
ex.az: MIDI 键盘：直接记录音符，不受噪音影响，之后可编辑。

cards.en:
Image input devices create digital image files. The common flatbed image scanner captures an image by pressing an object flat (photo/paper), projecting white light onto it and reading the reflected light with image sensors. Phone cameras with apps can act as scanners.
AttributeMeaning
Maximum document sizeflatbed usually up to A3
Pixel densitydots/pixels in a given area, in dpi / ppi; higher = better quality; often called "resolution"
Colour depthnumber of possible colours per pixel, in bits; higher = better quality
File formatdetermines the compression ratio (e.g. JPEG lossy lowers quality)
Memorybuilt-in RAM stores images temporarily during transfer (MB)
InterfaceUSB or network; state standards e.g. 802.11n / 802.11ac
Interface does not affect image quality. 3D scanners produce a digital 3D model of an object (e.g. a patient's teeth).
cards.zh:
平板扫描器 (flatbed scanner)：把物件压平，射出白光，用影像感应器读取反射光。规格：
  • 最大文件尺寸：通常至 A3
  • 像素密度 (pixel density)：单位 dpi/ppi，越高越清晰，规格上常叫 resolution
  • 色深 (colour depth)：每像素可有多少颜色，单位 bits，越高越好
  • 档案格式：决定压缩比（JPEG 有损会降低质素）
  • 记忆体：内置 RAM 暂存影像
  • 介面：USB 或网络（802.11n/ac）——不影响影像质素
3D 扫描器可把物件变成数码 3D 模型（如牙齿）。

ex.q: (Textbook Example 1.1 Q2) Which affect scanned image quality? (1) 4800 dpi (2) 802.11n supported (3) JPEG format
ex.a: (1) pixel density: affects quality. (2) connection only: no effect. (3) JPEG is lossy, lower quality than BMP/PNG: affects. Answer: (1) and (3) only.
ex.az: (1) 像素密度影响；(2) 只是连接方式；(3) JPEG 有损压缩影响质素。答案 (1)(3)。

cards.t: Calculating scanned image resolution and file size
cards.tz: 计算扫描影像解像度及档案大小
cards.en:
Resolution (pixels) = (width in inches × dpi) × (height in inches × dpi).
Uncompressed file size (bytes) = (colour depth ÷ 8) × width pixels × height pixels.
Convert: 1 KB = 1024 bytes, 1 MB = 10242 bytes.

Book example: an A4 page is 8.3 × 11.7 inches. At 300 dpi: (8.3×300) × (11.7×300) = 2490 × 3510 pixels. With 24-bit colour, uncompressed: (24÷8) × 2490 × 3510 = 26,219,700 bytes ÷ 10242 ≈ 25.0 MB. Doubling the dpi makes the pixel count (and file size) 4 times larger, since both width and height double.
cards.zh:
解像度 = (阔度英寸 × dpi) × (高度英寸 × dpi)。
未压缩档案大小 (bytes) = (色深 ÷ 8) × 横像素 × 直像素；1 MB = 1024² bytes。

课本例子：A4 = 8.3 × 11.7 英寸，300 dpi → 2490 × 3510 像素；24-bit 未压缩 = 3 × 2490 × 3510 = 26,219,700 bytes ≈ 25.0 MB。dpi 加倍，像素数目和档案大小变 4 倍（长和阔都加倍）。

ex.q: A 4 × 6 inch photo is scanned at 600 dpi, 24-bit, uncompressed. Find the resolution and file size in MB.

cards.en:
After scanning a paper document, the result is a digital image file; without further processing we cannot search for text in it. Optical character recognition (OCR) software converts an image into a text file, enabling word processing (editing) and data analysis. Common OCR software: Microsoft OneNote, Adobe Acrobat, Google Docs. It can even recognise handwritten text.

Do not confuse with OMR (optical mark recognition), which reads specific marks (e.g. darkened circles), not general text. A typical exam scenario: "paper forms/printed descriptions must be typed into a database" → scanner + OCR.
cards.zh:
扫描纸本后得到的是影像档，不能搜寻文字。OCR 软件把影像转成文字档，便于文书处理（编辑）和数据分析。常见：OneNote、Adobe Acrobat、Google Docs，甚至可识别手写字。

不要和 OMR（光学标记识别）混淆：OMR 只读特定符号（如涂黑的圆圈），不读一般文字。考试情境：纸本表格/印刷文字要输入数据库 → 扫描器 + OCR。

ex.q: (Textbook Checkpoint 1.1 Q3) Oscar types paper inquiry forms into a database. Suggest a device and technology.
ex.a: Use an image scanner to scan the forms into images, then OCR software to convert the images into text, which can be imported into the database. This saves typing time and reduces input errors.
ex.az: 用扫描器扫描表格，再用 OCR 转成文字导入数据库，省时并减少输入错误。

cards.t: Digital camera, digital video camera and webcam
cards.tz: 数码相机、数码录影机与网络摄影机
cards.en:
• Digital camera: captures still images using image sensors; stores them in memory cards or other built-in storage.
  • Digital video camera (video input device): like a digital camera but has a built-in microphone and records videos.
  • Webcam: not a portable handheld device; it connects directly to a computer and streams the recording online. Frequent data transfer during streaming is achieved at the cost of video quality, so webcams are mainly for video conferencing and video monitoring.
Video input devices create digital video files; image input devices create digital image files.
cards.zh:
• 数码相机：用影像感应器拍静态相片，存于记忆卡。
  • 数码录影机：类似数码相机，但有内置咪高峰，可录影。
  • 网络摄影机 (webcam)：不是手提设备，直接接电脑并在线串流；为了频繁传送数据而牺牲影片质素，主要用于视像会议和监察。

ex.q: A teacher wants to stream her lesson live to students at home. Which camera?
ex.a: A webcam: it connects directly to the computer and streams online in real time.
ex.az: 用 webcam，直接接电脑实时串流。

cards.t: Automatic input devices and optical readers
cards.tz: 自动输入设备与光学阅读器
cards.en:
Automatic input devices (e.g. barcode scanners, magnetic stripe card readers, OMR, sensors) let us input data automatically with minimal human effort. They usually involve conversion between types of multimedia elements, e.g. a QR code scanner converts a scanned image into a text string. They drastically reduce input time and input errors.

An optical reader scans visual data and converts it into digital data such as sequences of numbers and text strings. Optical readers include barcode scanners, QR code scanners and optical mark readers.
cards.zh:
自动输入设备（条码扫描器、磁带卡阅读器、OMR、感应器等）能以最少人力自动输入数据，通常涉及多媒体元素之间的转换（例如 QR 扫描器把影像转成文字串），可大幅减少输入时间和错误。

光学阅读器 (optical reader) 扫描视觉数据，转成数字序列或文字串，包括条码扫描器、QR 扫描器、OMR。

ex.q: State two benefits of automatic input devices over manual typing in a library.
ex.a: Faster input (almost instant); fewer human errors (no mistyping of ISBNs).
ex.az: 输入快；人为错误少。

cards.en:
Barcodes appear on products, coupons, books and parcels. They represent key information such as product IDs and ISBN, encoded in standards like the International Article Number. Barcode scanners convert barcodes into sequences of characters and send them to computers, so stock or book status can be updated almost instantly with minimal human error.

QR codes (Quick Response codes) are two-dimensional barcodes. Unlike barcodes (numbers only), they can represent text strings with any type of characters, e.g. phone numbers, email addresses, URLs. Uses: payments, discounts, signing in. Both can be scanned with a dedicated scanner or a mobile app. A QR code missing its position (corner) patterns or with too much damage cannot be read.
cards.zh:
条码 (barcode) 代表产品编号、ISBN 等；条码扫描器把条码转成字符序列送到电脑，几乎即时更新存货或借书状态，人为错误极少。

二维码 (QR code) 是二维条码，可储存任何字符的文字串（不只数字），如电话、电邮、URL，用于付款、优惠、登入。可用专用扫描器或手机 app 扫描。缺少角落定位图案或损坏太多的 QR code 读不到。

ex.q: Why does a shop use QR codes rather than barcodes for its website link?
ex.a: A URL contains letters and symbols; a barcode typically stores only a sequence of numbers, while a QR code can store text with any characters.
ex.az: URL 有字母和符号，条码一般只有数字，QR code 可存任何字符。

cards.en:
An optical mark reader is a scanner dedicated to scanning specific symbols; the input method is optical mark recognition (OMR). Marking MC answer sheets or entering paper questionnaires by hand is slow and risks human error; with OMR the data are read in seconds, provided the sheets are filled using specific symbols such as darkened circles.

That is why MC answer sheets say circles must be darkened completely: an OMR may fail to read a partly darkened circle, and the candidate may lose marks. OMR cannot convert free text into a text file; that needs OCR.
cards.zh: OMR 是专门扫描特定符号的扫描器，用于改 MC 答题纸、输入问卷。人手处理慢又易错，OMR 几秒就读完，但必须用指定符号（如涂黑圆圈）。所以答题纸要求完全涂黑，否则可能读不到而失分。OMR 不能把一般文字变成文字档，那是 OCR 的工作。

ex.q: (Textbook Ch1 Long Q5(b)) Peter suggests OMR to convert photographed text descriptions into a text file. Agree?
ex.a: Disagree. OMR only reads specific marks (e.g. darkened circles) at fixed positions, not general characters. She should use OCR, which converts an image of text into a text file.
ex.az: 不同意：OMR 只读特定标记；应用 OCR 把文字影像转成文字档。

cards.t: Magnetic stripe cards vs smart cards
cards.en:
Both readers scan cards; used in retail, finance and security, mainly for authentication (e.g. keycard access control, ATM cards, credit cards).
  • Magnetic stripe card: a coloured stripe of magnetic material; the reader reads data by sensing magnetism (swiping). They are prone to damage and easily replicated, so they are being replaced by smart cards.
  • Smart card: stores data in a microchip. Some have RFID (radio frequency identification) or NFC (near-field communication) tags for contactless communication with the reader (tapping, e.g. Octopus).
cards.zh:
两者都用于零售、金融、保安，主要做身份认证。
  • 磁带卡：有磁性物料的色带，读卡器感应磁性读取（拉卡）；易损坏、易被复制，正被智能卡取代。
  • 智能卡：数据存于微晶片 (microchip)；部分有 RFID 或 NFC 标签，可非接触式通讯（拍卡）。

ex.q: (Textbook Checkpoint 1.1 Q2) Correct statements? (1) Magnetic stripe cards are more durable than smart cards (2) Smart cards store data in microchips (3) Smart cards are harder to replicate
ex.a: (1) false: stripe cards are prone to damage. (2) true. (3) true. Answer: (2) and (3) only.

cards.en:
A sensor reads one or more physical quantities from the environment; common in smartphones, tablets and game consoles. Sensors convert one form of energy into another (hence "transducer"), and the output device can act on the data.
SensorMeasuresApplication
Light (photoresistor)brightnessauto-brightness on phones; automatic lighting
Ultrasonicdistanceautomatic hand washer; parking (obstacle distance)
Compassdirectionnavigation
Temperature & humiditytemperature, humiditycar air conditioning; overheat protection
Gyroscopeorientationrotating the phone screen
cards.zh:
感应器 (sensor) 从环境读取物理量，常见于手机、平板、游戏机；它把一种能量转换成另一种（所以也叫 transducer），输出设备再按数据作出反应。
  • 光感应器：亮度 → 自动调光、自动开灯
  • 超声波：距离 → 自动洗手机、泊车
  • 指南针：方向 → 导航
  • 温湿度：→ 汽车冷气、过热保护
  • 陀螺仪 (gyroscope)：方向/姿态 → 旋转屏幕

ex.q: A drill should stop when overheated. Which sensor?
ex.a: Temperature (and humidity) sensor: it measures temperature so the drill can halt above a threshold.
ex.az: 温度感应器。

cards.en:
Biometric devices scan and read people's physical or behavioural characteristics, e.g. fingerprint, face, iris and voice. They are used for authentication, because it is unlikely or even impossible for two people to share the same characteristics. Examples: phone fingerprint unlock, iris-scanner access control.

Note: these characteristics are private information, raising privacy-related ethical issues (Core E). Unlike a password or card, a biometric cannot be forgotten or lent, but it also cannot be changed if leaked.
cards.zh:
生物识别设备读取人的生理或行为特征（指纹、面容、虹膜、声音），用于身份认证，因为两人几乎不可能有相同特征。例如指纹解锁手机、虹膜门禁。

注意：这些是私隐资料，涉及私隐伦理问题；生物特征不会忘记也不能借出，但一旦外泄无法更改。

ex.q: Give one advantage and one concern of fingerprint door access over keycards.
ex.a: Advantage: cannot be lost, lent or copied easily. Concern: fingerprint data is private; if leaked it cannot be changed.
ex.az: 优点：不会遗失或借出；忧虑：私隐，外泄后无法更改。

cards.en:
Output devices are responsible for the last step of the IPO cycle: they output images, hard copies of documents, sound waves, etc. Like input devices, they can be wired or wireless.
TypeExampleConnection
Wiredwired speakers, wired earphonesUSB port; 3.5 mm phone connector
Wirelesswireless speakers, wireless earphonesRF (2.4 GHz); Bluetooth; Wi-Fi
Headphones usually connect by USB, 3.5 mm jack or Bluetooth; Wi-Fi is not common for headphones. Some devices are both input and output: touchscreens, VR headsets, headphones with microphones.
cards.zh: 输出设备负责 IPO 的最后一步，输出影像、文件硬拷贝、声音等。有线：USB、3.5 mm 耳机插头；无线：RF 2.4 GHz、蓝牙、Wi-Fi。耳机较少用 Wi-Fi 连接。部分设备同时是输入和输出：触控屏、VR 头戴装置、附咪高峰的耳机。

ex.q: Classify: touchscreen, plotter, webcam, headset with microphone.
ex.a: Output: plotter. Input: webcam. Both: touchscreen, headset with microphone.
ex.az: 输出：绘图机；输入：webcam；两者：触控屏、附咪耳机。

cards.t: LCD vs OLED monitors (and the LED misconception)
cards.tz: LCD 与 OLED 显示器（LED 误解）
cards.en:
Monitors display the user interface and the results of processing.
TypePrincipleAdvantages
LCDa backlight (CCFL or LED) shines through liquid crystals + polarisers, which filter it to make colourlower price; more screen size options
OLEDOLED itself is the source of light and colour; no backlighthigher contrast ratio, more consistent brightness, wider viewing angle, lighter, some foldable/flexible
Misconception: "OLED = LED monitor" is wrong. An "LED monitor" is an LCD with LED backlight (LED-backlit LCD); OLED is fundamentally different. OLED is gradually replacing LCD. CRT monitors (electron guns hitting fluorescent material) are rare now: bulky, low image quality. LCD backlights from the edges make brightness less even.
cards.zh:
显示器 (monitor) 显示界面和处理结果。
  • LCD：由背光（CCFL 或 LED）穿过液晶和偏光片过滤出颜色；优点：较便宜、尺寸选择多。
  • OLED：自己发光发色，不需背光；优点：对比度高、亮度一致、可视角度阔、较轻、可折叠/弯曲。
误解：OLED ≠ LED 显示器。所谓 LED 显示器其实是 LED 背光的 LCD。OLED 正逐渐取代 LCD。CRT 已少见：笨重、画质低。

ex.q: A gallery wants a very thin, flexible display with deep blacks. LCD or OLED?
ex.a: OLED: no backlight, so it can be thin/flexible and pixels can turn off for a higher contrast ratio.
ex.az: OLED：不需背光，可弯曲，对比度高。

cards.t: Monitor specifications: screen size, resolution, aspect ratio, refresh rate, colour depth
cards.en:
• Screen size: length of the diagonal in inches (computer monitors usually 22 to 24 inches).
  • Resolution: number of pixels on the screen, e.g. 1366×768, 1600×900, 1920×1080 (HD), 2560×1440, 3840×2160 (4K), 7680×4320 (8K).
  • Colour depth: number of possible colours a pixel can be; higher = better.
  • Aspect ratio: width : height; common 16:9, 16:10, 4:3. 2560×1440 → divide by HCF 160 → 16:9.
  • Refresh rate: times per second the screen updates its image, in Hz (60, 75, 120, 144 Hz). Higher = smoother motion.
  • Interface: VGA, DVI, HDMI, DisplayPort.
Letterboxing (enrichment): if the video's aspect ratio differs from the monitor's, blank (black) spaces are added (or the image is cropped) to avoid stretching.
cards.zh:
• 屏幕尺寸：对角线长度（英寸），一般 22–24 吋。
  • 解像度：屏幕像素数，如 1920×1080 (HD)、3840×2160 (4K)。
  • 色深：每像素可显示的颜色数。
  • 长宽比 (aspect ratio)：阔:高，常见 16:9、16:10、4:3；2560×1440 ÷160 = 16:9。
  • 更新率 (refresh rate)：每秒更新画面次数，单位 Hz，越高越流畅。
  • 介面：VGA、DVI、HDMI、DisplayPort。
Letterboxing：影片长宽比与屏幕不同时，会加黑边（或裁切）以免变形。

ex.q: Find the aspect ratio of 1680 × 1050 and 1920 × 1200.
ex.az: 两者都是 16:10。

cards.en:
Pixel density (ppi) = diagonal resolution ÷ screen size, where diagonal resolution = √(width² + height²) in pixels.
Same size, higher resolution → higher density; same resolution, larger screen → lower density. Higher density → sharper image.
Examples: 24-inch 1920×1080: √(1920²+1080²) ÷ 24 ≈ 91.79 ppi. 86-inch TV 1920×1080: ÷ 86 ≈ 25.62 ppi.
Rearranged: screen size = diagonal resolution ÷ pixel density. So with equal ppi, the higher-resolution monitor is the larger one (Textbook Example 1.2 Q2). Equal colour depth does not guarantee equal image quality (e.g. LCD brightness consistency is lower).
cards.zh:
像素密度 = 对角线像素 ÷ 屏幕尺寸，对角线像素 = √(阔² + 高²)。同尺寸解像度越高 → 密度越高；同解像度屏幕越大 → 密度越低。
例：24 吋 1920×1080 ≈ 91.79 ppi；86 吋电视 ≈ 25.62 ppi。
变形：屏幕尺寸 = 对角线像素 ÷ 像素密度，所以 ppi 相同时解像度高的屏幕较大。色深相同不代表画质相同。

ex.q: (Textbook Ch1 Long Q2(b)(i)) Set X: 1920×1080, 24"; Set Y: 3840×2160, 27". Find each pixel density.
ex.a:
X: √(1920²+1080²) = 2202.9; ÷24 ≈ 91.79 ppi.
Y: √(3840²+2160²) = 4405.8; ÷27 ≈ 163.18 ppi.
Y has the higher pixel density, so its images look sharper/more detailed.
ex.az: X ≈ 91.79 ppi；Y ≈ 163.18 ppi，Y 较清晰。

cards.t: Display ports: VGA, DVI, HDMI, DisplayPort
cards.en:
Monitors connect through ports or networks.
PortAudio?Resolution supported
VGANoLow
DVINoMedium
HDMIYesHigh
DisplayPortYesHigh
If a monitor must play sound from the computer over a single cable, choose HDMI or DisplayPort. VGA is analog and oldest.
cards.zh: 显示器介面：VGA（无音频，低解像度）、DVI（无音频，中）、HDMI（有音频，高）、DisplayPort（有音频，高）。如要一条线同时传影像和声音，用 HDMI 或 DisplayPort。

ex.q: A 4K monitor with built-in speakers must connect with one cable. Which ports are suitable?
ex.a: HDMI or DisplayPort: both carry audio and support high resolution.
ex.az: HDMI 或 DisplayPort。

cards.en:
Projectors project images onto a surface; used in lessons, meetings and film screenings where the screen must be shown to a large group.
Monitor advantagesProjector advantages
higher image quality
less affected by ambient light
no need for a plain flat surface
suitable for personal use		lighter
more portable
adjustable screen size, can be much larger
suitable for large audiences
Limitation of projectors: poor in bright environments (e.g. outdoors in daytime), needs a flat surface, lower image quality. A VR headset (enrichment) combines input (motion/orientation tracking) and output (display).
cards.zh:
投影机把影像投射到表面，用于上课、会议、放映给大量观众。
显示器优点：画质较高、较少受环境光影响、不需平坦表面、适合个人。
投影机优点：较轻、便携、画面尺寸可调且可很大、适合大群观众。
局限：光猛环境（如日间户外）效果差。VR 头戴装置同时是输入（追踪动作方向）及输出。

ex.q: (Textbook Checkpoint 1.2 Q1) Advantages of a projector over a monitor: (1) works better outdoor in daytime (2) adjustable screen size (3) easier to transport
ex.a: (1) false: projectors are more affected by ambient light. (2) true. (3) true. Answer: (2) and (3) only.

cards.en:
Printers produce hard copies (electronic documents in paper form).
AttributeMeaning
Printing sizeusually A4 or letter
Dot densitydots in a given area, in dpi; higher = better; often called "resolution" (e.g. 1200 dpi)
Monochrome / colourone colour vs mixing many colours
Printing speedprintouts per duration, in pages per minute (ppm)
Memorybuilt-in RAM stores data temporarily (MB)
InterfaceUSB or network (802.11n/ac)
cards.zh: 打印机产生硬拷贝。规格：打印尺寸（A4/letter）、点密度 dpi（越高越好，常称 resolution，如 1200 dpi）、单色/彩色、打印速度 ppm（每分钟页数）、内置 RAM、介面（USB/网络）。

ex.q: Which is an example of a printer's resolution: 2'×3', 200×200, 1200 dpi, HD ready?
ex.a: 1200 dpi: printer resolution is dot density in dots per inch.

cards.tz: 感热式、喷墨及激光打印机
cards.en:
• Thermal printer: heats thermal paper (heat-sensitive, changes colour). Fast, quiet, low cost, small/light, durable (few moving parts); used for receipts. But printouts fade over time (heat/chemicals), so not for long-term documents; usually monochrome.
  • Inkjet printer: sprays ink droplets from ink cartridges. Affordable purchase price, very high dot density, colour; but slow, high cost per page, may clog/misalign, printouts blur when wet.
  • Laser printer: (1) laser beams alter the charge of a photosensitive drum; (2) toner is attracted to the drum; (3) as the drum rolls, toner is heated and stuck onto paper. Fast, low cost per page, not affected by water; but very high purchase price, higher power use; common in offices.
ThermalInkjetLaser
PurchaseLowHighVery high
Cost/pageLowHighLow
SpeedFastSlowFast
Dot densityLowVery highHigh
cards.zh:
• 感热式：加热感热纸；快、静、平、细、耐用；用于收据；但会褪色，不适合长期保存。
  • 喷墨：从墨盒喷墨点；售价较低、点密度很高、彩色；但慢、每页成本高、墨头可能堵塞、遇水化开。
  • 激光：激光改变感光鼓电荷 → 碳粉被吸附 → 加热黏到纸上。快、每页成本低、不怕水；但机价很高、耗电较高；多用于办公室。

ex.q: (Textbook Example 1.3 Q2) Mandy must print warranty certificates at the POS. Thermal, plotter, 3D or laser?
ex.a: Certificates are kept for months or years; thermal printouts fade. A plotter is overkill; a 3D printer makes objects. Choose a laser printer: durable, long-lasting printouts.
ex.az: 保修证要长期保存，感热纸会褪色；选激光打印机。

cards.t: Dot matrix printer, plotter and 3D printer
cards.tz: 点阵打印机、绘图机与 3D 打印机
cards.en:
• Dot matrix printer (historical): presses pins on an ink-soaked ribbon against paper; very low dot density and quality, but the pressure lets it print on multipart (carbonless copy) forms producing multiple copies at the same time, so not fully replaced. Thermal printers beat it in being quieter, faster and smaller.
  • Plotter: expensive printer specialised in high-quality vector drawings, drawing precisely by moving pens continuously rather than dot by dot (ink or toner). Used for engineering/architectural drawings.
  • 3D printer: produces physical objects from digital 3D models, using various principles and materials. Used in medicine (customised dentures, limb prostheses), architecture and art (faster preview of designs and prototypes). Compared with moulding: faster, less waste of materials.
cards.zh:
• 点阵打印机：针撞色带印字，质素低，但可一次打印多联单（过底纸），所以未完全淘汰。感热式比它更静、更快、更细。
  • 绘图机 (plotter)：昂贵，用笔连续移动画出高质素向量图，不是逐点打印。
  • 3D 打印机：按数码 3D 模型制造实物；医学（假牙、义肢）、建筑与艺术（快速制作原型）；比模具更快、浪费较少。

ex.q: A dental clinic wants customised dentures quickly. Which output device? Give one benefit over moulding.
ex.a: A 3D printer; it is faster and has less waste of materials, and each denture can be customised from a 3D scan.
ex.az: 3D 打印机：较快、浪费少、可度身订造。

cards.en:
Speakers, headphones and earphones connect to the computer's sound card and play sounds (analog signals). They can be wired or wireless and are usually used in a pair to give stereophonic (stereo) sound for a sense of presence. Headphones with microphones are both input and output (studio recording, video conferencing).
SpeakersHeadphones / earphones
a large group can hear
surround sound with multiple speakers
less risk of hearing damage
do not hinder user movement		more privacy, less disturbance to others
smaller, lighter, portable
less affected by ambient noise
cards.zh:
扬声器、头戴式耳机、入耳式耳机接声效卡播放声音（类比讯号），通常成对使用，提供立体声。附咪耳机同时是输入及输出。
扬声器：多人可同时听、可做环迴立体声、较少损害听力、不妨碍活动。
耳机：私隐高、不打扰他人、细小轻便、较少受环境噪音影响。

ex.q: (Textbook Checkpoint 1.2 Q2) Listening test for 100 students in a hall: one advantage and one disadvantage of speakers over headphones.
ex.a: Advantage: one set lets all 100 students hear at once (cheaper, easier to set up). Disadvantage: sound is uneven across the hall and affected by ambient noise/echo, so some students may not hear clearly.
ex.az: 优点：一套即可让全部人听；缺点：受噪音/回音影响，不同位置清晰度不一。

cards.t: Business use: video conferencing and cashier service
cards.tz: 商业应用：视像会议与收银
cards.en:
Video conferencing is a live meeting connecting more than one party over the internet remotely. Companies can hold meetings without gathering employees in one place, improving productivity and saving transportation time and cost, especially during a pandemic. Devices needed: webcam (visual input), microphone, speakers/headphones, monitor.

Cashier service: paper receipts usually come from thermal printers, known for fast and quiet printing with low printing costs; they are small and relatively cheap, so favourable for cashiers.
cards.zh:
视像会议：经互联网远程连接多于一方的实时会议；不用聚在同一地方，提升生产力、节省交通时间和成本，疫情期间尤其有用。需要 webcam、咪高峰、扬声器/耳机、显示器。

收银：收据多由感热式打印机打印：快、静、成本低、细小、便宜。

ex.q: (Textbook Checkpoint 1.3 Q1) Devices usually needed for video conferencing: (1) microphone (2) webcam (3) MIDI keyboard
ex.a: Microphone and webcam capture voice and video; a MIDI keyboard is for music. Answer: (1) and (2) only.
ex.az: 咪高峰和 webcam；MIDI 键盘无关。

cards.t: Electronic payment: POS terminal and self-service terminal
cards.tz: 电子支付：POS 与自助终端
cards.en:
Retailers adopt electronic payment systems or self-checkout systems to facilitate transactions and reduce labour costs.
Point-of-sales (POS) terminal devices:
DeviceRole
Magnetic stripe / smart card readerread card data for payment
Numpadenter passwords for authentication
Barcode scannerscan products → name, price, offers from product ID
QR code scannermembership cards; electronic payment
Receipt (thermal) printerprint receipt after transaction
A self-service terminal is an upgraded POS terminal: most of the same devices plus a touchscreen and user interface, so customers finish transactions themselves (e.g. fast-food ordering kiosk). Touchscreens suit kiosks: easy to use, input and output in one, no extra space for keyboard/mouse.
cards.zh:
零售商用电子支付或自助结帐以方便交易、减少人手成本。
POS 终端：磁带卡/智能卡阅读器（付款）、数字键盘（输入密码）、条码扫描器（读产品资料）、QR 扫描器（会员、电子付款）、收据打印机。
自助终端是 POS 的升级版，多了触控屏和用户界面，顾客自行完成交易（如快餐店点餐机）。触控屏易用、输入输出合一、省位。

ex.q: (Textbook Example 1.3 Q1) Devices commonly seen in a self-checkout: (1) smart card reader (2) headphone (3) barcode scanner
ex.a: Card reader for payment; barcode scanner for product data; headphones are not needed. Answer: (1) and (3) only.

cards.t: Educational use: online lessons, library circulation, museum kiosks
cards.en:
• Online lesson: video conferencing lets learning continue regardless of weather, location, traffic and pandemic. Students need a webcam, microphone, monitor and speakers/headphones.
  • Library circulation: library catalogue terminals and self-charging terminals let users check catalogues and borrow books without librarians. A self-charging terminal has: smart card reader (scans and validates the library card), barcode scanner (reads the book barcode, finds info by ISBN), touchscreen (simple user interface), receipt printer.
  • Museum exhibition: information kiosks let visitors learn about the collection without a tour guide.
For accessibility (visually impaired users), kiosks can add speakers/headphone jack with screen reader (audio output) and a microphone (speech recognition) or a Braille keypad.
cards.zh:
• 网上课堂：视像会议令学习不受天气、地点、交通、疫情影响。
  • 图书馆借还：目录终端和自助借书机，不用馆员。自助借书机有：智能卡阅读器（读证）、条码扫描器（按 ISBN 找书资料）、触控屏、收据打印机。
  • 博物馆：资讯站 (kiosk) 让访客不用导赏员也能了解展品。
为视障人士：可加扬声器/耳机读出内容、咪高峰（语音识别）或点字键盘。

ex.q: (Textbook Ch1 Long Q3(b)) Visually impaired users cannot use touchscreen kiosks. Suggest two devices and how they help.
ex.a:
Speakers/headphones: read out on-screen information and options (text-to-speech), so users need not see the screen.
Microphone: users speak their query, which is input by speech recognition instead of typing on the screen.
ex.az: 扬声器读出内容；咪高峰让用户以语音输入。

mc.q: Which device is most suitable for creating comic illustrations?
mc.e: A drawing (graphics) tablet has pen control and many pressure levels.
mc.ez: 绘图板用笔并有压力感应。

mc.q: During online lessons, which of the following input devices may be used? (1) Monitor (2) Webcam (3) Printer
mc.e: Monitor and printer are output devices; only the webcam is input.
mc.ez: 只有 webcam 是输入设备。

mc.q: Which medium is NOT common in connecting headphones and computers?
mc.e: Headphones connect by USB, 3.5 mm jack or Bluetooth; Wi-Fi is uncommon.

mc.q: A powered drill should detect if it is overheated and halt automatically. Which sensor should be used?
Which is an application of OCR software?
o: Converting printed documents into a digital text file
Checking whether answers on an MC answer sheet are correct
Checking differences between two document files
mc.e: OCR converts images of text into text. MC sheets use OMR; subtitles use speech recognition.
mc.ez: OCR 把文字影像转成文字档。

cards.en:
A system unit contains the main components of a computer system: the motherboard, processors (CPU, GPU), storage devices (main memory and secondary storage), interface cards and the power supply unit (PSU).
ComponentFunction
MotherboardServes as a platform to connect all the components of a computer together.
ProcessorProcesses data and instructions; controls the operation of the computer system.
Main memory / primary storageRAM: stores data temporarily for processing. ROM: stores firmware, a collection of instructions required to start a computer.
Secondary storageStores data for future use.
PSUProvides power to a computer for operation.
External devices connected to the system unit are peripheral devices, usually input or output devices. Chipsets are collections of chips (integrated circuits, tiny electronic circuits) found in some components. Memorise the function wording in the table: exam MCs often swap the functions between components.
cards.zh:
System unit（主機）包含電腦的主要組件：motherboard（主機板）、processor（處理器，如 CPU、GPU）、storage devices（main memory 主記憶體 + secondary storage 輔助儲存器）、介面卡和 power supply unit (PSU) 電源供應器。
功能要背英文：Motherboard connects all the components together；Processor processes data and instructions and controls the operation；RAM stores data temporarily for processing；ROM stores firmware required to start a computer；Secondary storage stores data for future use；PSU provides power。
接到主機外面的設備叫 peripheral devices（周邊設備），通常是輸入或輸出設備。Chipset 是一組晶片（integrated circuits 集成電路）。考試 MC 常把組件和功能配錯，要分清楚。

ex.q: Which pair is correct? A. Processor: connects all components; B. Motherboard: handles complex calculations; C. Main memory: stores data temporarily for processing; D. Secondary storage: stores programs needed to turn on the computer.
ex.a: Processor processes data (not connecting) so A is wrong. Motherboard connects components, so B is wrong. RAM (main memory) stores data temporarily for processing, so C is correct. The startup firmware is in ROM, which is main memory, not secondary storage, so D is wrong. Answer: C.
ex.az: 處理器負責運算，主機板負責連接；開機程式（firmware）在 ROM，不在輔助儲存器。答案 C。

cards.t: Which components must a system unit have?
cards.en: Every system unit must have a CPU and RAM: RAM stores the data currently in use by the CPU and nothing else can replace it. It must also have at least one secondary storage device, but this does not have to be a hard disk; an SSD is an alternative. A dedicated graphics card is not a must, because an iGPU (integrated GPU) can be used instead. RAID is optional too. So in 'must be found' questions: CPU, RAM, motherboard, PSU, some secondary storage = yes; hard disk, graphics card, optical drive, RAID = not necessarily.
cards.zh:
每部主機一定要有 CPU 和 RAM（RAM 存放 CPU 正在使用的資料，沒有其他東西能代替）。一定要有至少一個輔助儲存器，但不一定是 hard disk，可以用 SSD。獨立顯示卡（dedicated graphics card）不是必須，因為可以用 iGPU。RAID、光碟機也不是必須。
做「must be found in a system unit」題：CPU、RAM、主機板、PSU、某種輔助儲存器 = 必須；hard disk、graphics card、ODD、RAID = 不一定。

ex.q: Which must be found in a system unit? (1) RAM (2) Hard disk (3) Dedicated graphics card
ex.a: (1) RAM is a must. (2) secondary storage is needed but it can be an SSD instead of a hard disk. (3) an iGPU can replace a dedicated card. Answer: (1) only (Textbook Example 2.1 Q1).
ex.az: RAM 必須；硬碟可用 SSD 代替；顯示卡可用 iGPU 代替。只有 (1)。

cards.en:
A motherboard is a circuit board that provides slots and ports for connecting electrical components or peripheral devices, e.g. CPU, RAM, graphics card and monitor.
Slot/portExample of devices
SATA (Serial advanced technology attachment) slotSecondary storage: hard disks, SSD
PCIe (Peripheral component interconnect express) slotGraphics cards, sound cards, network interface cards (NIC)
USB portMice, keyboards, USB flash drives
VGA or HDMI portDisplay units: monitors, projectors
M.2 portMost components connectable by SATA, PCIe and USB, e.g. secondary storage and graphics cards
Modern motherboards may have integrated interfaces (network, graphics, sound). These replace external interface cards, which are usually more expensive, so the cost of building a computer is lowered. That is the key advantage of an integrated sound/network card: lower cost (not better performance).
cards.zh:
Motherboard（主機板）是一塊電路板，提供插槽和連接埠（slots and ports）連接 CPU、RAM、顯示卡、顯示器等。
要記：SATA 接 hard disk/SSD；PCIe 接顯示卡、音效卡、網卡（NIC）；USB 接滑鼠、鍵盤、USB 手指；VGA/HDMI 接顯示器、投影機；M.2 可接大部分 SATA/PCIe/USB 可接的組件，例如儲存裝置和顯示卡。
現在主機板常內置介面（integrated interfaces），例如網絡、圖形、聲音，取代較貴的外置介面卡，所以降低砌機成本。內置音效卡的優點是 lower cost，不是效能更好。
